src: monochrome foreground masks s in the 2x2 quadrants, ordered back-to-front by quadrant position: top-left, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right
dst: layers d of the half-size output canvas ordered back-to-front
transform: fold each mask onto its local coordinates and stamp it with its quadrant color; later layers overwrite earlier overlaps
grid_shape: output is one quadrant: input height/2 by input width/2
